tools.name: bid_checklist
tools.description: Get six items to compare in a home-project bid and optional trade-specific preparation. Omit trade for the general checklist; the answer's trade is then null. The answer includes sourceUrl.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Every US ZIP can post a job. Homeowners anywhere in the US can post a job; once you send it, InstaBids finds contractors to bid on it. Returns guidance and whether the input is a US ZIP, plus nearby town pages. Get the answer for a five-digit ZIP, and list towns with an InstaBids town page for a fiv

tools.name: permit_facts
tools.description: Read sourced local permit facts, with the date each rule was checked; unpublished rules get guidance to ask your bidder and confirm local requirements. Homeowners anywhere in the US can post a job; once you send it, InstaBids finds contractors to bid on it.

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Use this when a homeowner wants contractor bids on a home repair or improvement job in the US. Creates a private draft from their description and five-digit ZIP and returns a one-hour link for the homeowner to open. Nothing reaches a contractor until the homeowner confirms their email and sends it.

tools.name: reissue_claim_link
tools.description: Returns a replacement link for the homeowner to open and claim their draft. The old link stops working. Rate limited; unknown or expired statusHandle values receive the same generic NOT_FOUND answer. Only the homeowner sends the job to contractors inside InstaBids; this tool cannot send it.

tools.name: job_guidance
tools.description: Get must-have questions and photo asks from the current intake template for any trade. Unknown trades use the generic template. No prices or budget questions.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Returns the status, ZIP code, progress and bid count for one of the signed-in homeowner's InstaBids jobs. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: how_instabids_works, check_service_area, permit_facts, start_job, ask_next, answer_intake, how_contractors_join, get_home_profile, get_updates · Private data: how_instabids_works, start_job, ask_next, answer_intake, list_bids, check_approval, get_home_profile, get_project_history · Public sink: check_service_area, permit_facts, start_job, ask_next, answer_intake, reissue_claim_link, job_status, list_bids, prepare_publish, check_approval, get_home_profile · Destructive: how_instabids_works, how_contractors_join.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: how_instabids_works, check_service_area, permit_facts, start_job, ask_next, answer_intake, how_contractors_join, get_home_profile, get_updates · Private data: how_instabids_works, start_job, ask_next, answer_intake, list_bids, check_approval, get_home_profile, get_project_history · Public sink: check_service_area, permit_facts, start_job, ask_next, answer_intake, reissue_claim_link, job_status, list_bids, prepare_publish, check_approval, get_home_profile · Destructive: how_instabids_works, how_contractors_join

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
